appName: VR Travel Paris Bus Tour Full Experience
displayName: VR Travel Paris Bus Tour Full Experience
display_name: VR Travel Paris Bus Tour Full Experience
display_long_description:
Step into a moving bus tour of Paris – so real, you'll feel like you're there.
The VRtravelX ride begins at the iconic Opéra Garnier, passes the Louvre, glides along the Seine, and takes you by the majestic Notre-Dame Cathedral. Through the panoramic window, the city unfolds in full motion – with street sounds, distant bells, voices, and the vibrant pulse of everyday Paris.

This is no stop-and-go sightseeing tour – it's pure urban flow.
You'll cruise past Madeleine Church, see the Grand Palais, and catch a sweeping view of the Eiffel Tower. Even the golden dome of Les Invalides appears as part of the journey. VRtravelX doesn’t present a polished tourist loop – it gives you a seat on a real moving bus, with the sounds and rhythm of the city surrounding you.

It’s not a tour. It’s a mental getaway.
Pause your day and let Paris roll by – no stress, no crowds, no schedules. Just the sensation of drifting through one of the world’s most iconic cities. As the bus glides through neighborhoods, the soundscape surrounds you: footsteps on cobblestones, muffled engines, distant café chatter. You’re not observing from outside – you’re inside the rhythm of the city. The VRtravelX Paris Bus Tour lets you step away from everything, anytime you need.

This app includes streamed experiences and requires a stable internet connection. 
Streamed content is provided by the developer and may not be available indefinitely.

#VRTravelX #travel #VR #VirtualReality #Paris
